brief:
Israeli military operations in Jenin refugee camp have continued for 592 consecutive days, while military activities in Tulkarem and its refugee camps have lasted 586 days, IMEMC News reported. The sustained offensive has targeted multiple refugee camps across the occupied West Bank simultaneously.

Operations in Nur Shams refugee camp, located east of Tulkarem, remain active as part of the broader campaign. The military presence in these camps has now extended well beyond eighteen months, with no indication of withdrawal. Palestinian civilians in the affected areas have faced prolonged disruption to daily life and access to services during the extended operations.
